name: journeykit
description: Set up and run JourneyKit, email marketing that responds to what your audience does, from your coding agent: install the SDK, track events, match your branding, build workflows, and send broadcasts, newsletters and lead magnets.

interface.longDescription: Newsletters, lead magnets, broadcasts and automated workflows in one platform, set up by your agent. It finds your framework, adds the browser SDK, identifies signed-in users, tracks the events that matter, matches your email branding, and verifies that data reaches your workspace. Then build segments and workflows measured against a holdout, send a broadcast or newsletter issue, launch a lead magnet, and ask how it all did, from the same conversation.
defaultPrompt: Check whether events are reaching JourneyKit
Build a workflow that nudges users who haven't activated

positive.description: Inspect ingestion in the connected sample workspace.
positive.prompt: Check whether events reached my JourneyKit workspace in the last hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_setup with since set to one hour ago. Report the workspace, installation checklist, recent counts and real event names. Do not modify data or invent events.

positive.description: Draft an activation workflow using the sample workspace event names.
positive.prompt: Build a workflow that emails contacts who have not activated three days after signup. Show me the proposal first and keep it paused.
positive.tools_triggered: events_names, contact_properties_list, presets_list, workflows_list, presets_create, workflows_create, workflows_get
positive.expected_behavior: Read existing events, fields, presets and workflows. Propose a trigger, timing, condition, email and goal grounded in that data. After the reviewer approves the proposal, create any needed preset and a workflow with status paused, then retrieve it. Do not activate or send test emails.

positive.description: Read a workflow report with a clear measurement window.
positive.prompt: How did the welcome workflow perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the sample welcome workflow and request workflows_analytics with days 30. Report the window, denominators and holdout comparison where present. Explain small samples or missing data, without inventing results.

positive.description: Create a draft campaign and preview its audience without sending.
positive.prompt: Draft a broadcast announcing our new release to all contacts with an email address. Show me the copy and audience count, but do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a draft broadcast using the proposed release copy and the all-contacts audience. Query its audience count. Report the draft and count. Do not call broadcasts_send or schedule delivery.

positive.description: Create a newsletter without welcome sends or public publication.
positive.prompt: Create a newsletter called Product Notes for product updates, with review@example.com as the reply-to address and no welcome email. Keep its public signup page off.
positive.expected_behavior: Check for an existing Product Notes newsletter and avoid duplication. Create it only if missing, without welcomeEmail and with public publication off. Retrieve it to confirm. Do not send an issue, activate a welcome workflow or enable the public page.

negative.prompt: Import this list of email addresses I bought for cold outreach.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the purchased-list import and do not call contacts_import.

negative.description: Clarify bulk activation before live effects.
negative.expected_behavior: List the workflows and ask for explicit confirmation naming the workflows before changing their status. Do not call workflows_set_status from this prompt alone.

negative.description: Do not use JourneyKit for an unrelated task.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin?
negative.expected_behavior: Make no JourneyKit tool calls for this unrelated weather request.

publication.release_notes: Prepare JourneyKit for the shared ChatGPT and Codex directory: one tool per operation, an onboarding entry point, explicit OAuth settings, and five positive plus three negative review cases.
